description: This Java class 'KvUtil' provides utility methods for extracting typed values (String, Double, Long, Boolean) from 'KvEntry' objects, based on their data types.

classes.name: KvUtil
classes.description: Utility class for retrieving typed values from KvEntry objects.

methods.name: getStringValue
methods.description: Returns the string representation of the KvEntry's value based on its data type.

methods.name: getDoubleValue
methods.description: Returns the double representation of the KvEntry's value based on its data type.

methods.name: getLongValue
methods.description: Returns the long representation of the KvEntry's value based on its data type.

methods.name: getBoolValue
methods.description: Returns the boolean representation of the KvEntry's value based on its data type.
